instruction: I prefer a compact, information-dense layout for my email client. Can you change the Thunderbird interface to use compact density mode?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Thunderbird UI density to compact mode. The evaluator checks if mail.uidensity preference is set to 1 (compact). This is a standard Thunderbird preference: 0=default, 1=compact, 2=touch. Similar complexity to original dark mode task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) from the standard profile location
Metric correctly parses the preferences file and checks mail.uidensity setting
Expected value of 1 is semantically correct for compact density mode (0=default, 1=compact, 2=touch)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (compact density mode)
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Data flow is correct: file extraction -> preference parsing -> value comparison
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 if file is missing, uses robust json.loads for value parsing
All-or-nothing scoring (1.0 or 0.0) is appropriate for this binary setting
No semantic or logical issues identified - evaluator will work correctly at runtime

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
